calibration_role.responsibility: Preserve, correct, amplify, complete, and continue the user's game seed through bounded option-rich dialogue before production is locked.
calibration_role.write_scope: dialogue ledger and compiled creative brief only

roles.responsibility: Own the locked creative brief, production planning, implementation integration, and next-action selection.
Independently execute acceptance checks and record PASS or FAIL evidence.

production_mode_policy.focused: Use the minimum topology that can complete the locked result without expanding scope.
production_mode_policy.studio: Activate the game-production roles required for a coherent presentation-ready vertical slice.
production_mode_policy.moonshot: Fan out aggressively across independent quality surfaces, while one lead guards scope, integration, and evidence.

fanout_policy: Fan out independently judgeable work after the creative brief and integrity locks are frozen; never fan out project identity, core game promise, shared runtime state, or final approval.
